subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this issue close only after both Control UI and native WebChat tool outputs linkify URLs, or should the first fix narrow the issue to Control UI and track native parity separately?
rationale: The Control UI repair shape is clear, but the issue title and body include native WebChat; automation should not decide whether web-only behavior satisfies the broader request.

options.title: Narrow To Control UI First
options.body: Implement and prove complete Control UI tool-output linkification now, then split native WebChat parity into a follow-up if maintainers still want it.

options.title: Require Full Parity
options.body: Keep this issue open until both Control UI and native WebChat render safe clickable links in tool output.

options.title: Make It Web-Only
options.body: Declare native WebChat out of scope and close this only after Control UI behavior is implemented and proven.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Control UI First
recommendation.body: Implement and prove complete Control UI tool-output linkification now, then split native WebChat parity into a follow-up if maintainers still want it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already made the latest scope call on this issue and has current history on both affected rendering surfaces.
